'''Ord Mantell base''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It had a medical facility where [[Omega Squad]] member [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] was once treated.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
